_comment: Visual identity for image/video generation (headshots, classroom
stills, TikTok and ads). Built from PERSONALITY + GENDER only -
NOTHING here is derived from the tutor's display name, because
names are placeholders that will be replaced. When renaming this
tutor, pick a name that fits THIS file, not the reverse.
Gender and register are copied from tutor.md's documented

identity._heritage_note: a deliberate casting choice for a representative South African line-up; not inferred from any name
identity.build: lean and wiry, loose-limbed, constantly in motion

face: angular face with a strong jaw, expressive raised brows, bright quick eyes, medium-brown skin with warm undertone, thin chinstrap beard and moustache
hair: short fade with a sharp line-up, small twists on top

wardrobe.teaching: bomber jacket or work jacket over a graphic tee, tapered chinos or jeans, clean white sneakers
alternates: short-sleeve button-up open over a tee
hoodie under the jacket for night clips

accessories: phone in hand as a prop
coins or a folded note when he talks price

presence.posture: never still - counts on his fingers, sketches a curve in the air, steps toward the camera to make a point
presence.default_expression: animated and amused, eyebrows up, mid-sentence energy
presence.energy: taxi-rank storyteller - fast, funny, completely at ease

environment: street or rank backdrop softly blurred, minibus and traders out of focus, or a classroom with one bold sketch on the board
_continuity_note: the features that MUST survive every regeneration - if these read the same, the audience accepts it as the same person

negative_prompt: cartoon, illustration, 3d render, cgi, airbrushed skin, waxy skin, plastic sheen, over-saturated colours, HDR halos, extra fingers, malformed hands, distorted ears, text, watermark, logo, subtitles, teeth artefacts, dead eyes, American classroom props, chalkboard gibberish, unreadable equations, generic stock-photo smile

headshot.lighting: large softbox key at 45 degrees, subtle hair light, grey seamless or softly blurred classroom background
headshot.framing: chest-up, eyes on the upper third, slight three-quarter turn

classroom.camera: full-frame, 35mm f/2.8 for context or 50mm f/2 for waist-up
classroom.lighting: practical daylight from classroom windows plus soft fill; avoid flat overhead fluorescent
classroom.framing: waist-up with the board visible over the shoulder, or wider three-quarter with the tutor mid-gesture

video.framing: 9:16 vertical for TikTok - head and shoulders in the top two thirds, room for captions below
video.continuity: same wardrobe, same accessories and same hairstyle across a campaign; regenerate from continuity_anchors rather than re-describing from scratch
